name: ChatInput
description: A chat-style input component with an auto-growing textarea and submit button. Designed for conversational UIs like refinement prompts or chat interfaces.
usage: Chat-style input with textarea and submit button
A native text field: value + the native onChange(event) for controlled, defaultValue for uncontrolled (it clears after a submit)
onSubmit(value) is the commit: the button, or Enter without Shift (not while an IME composition is open, not over maxLength)
An app's onKeyDown, onFocus and onBlur run before the component's; preventDefault in onKeyDown skips Enter-to-submit
Optional label, helperText, error and touched: an error shows at once unless touched is false
Auto-growing textarea that expands with content up to a max height
Optional character limit with visual counter
Loading state disables input and shows spinner on button
design: Stacked layout: chromeless textarea on top, action row below.
Outer container has rounded border that shows focus/error states.
Textarea is borderless with transparent background (chromeless inside container).
Bottom row has character counter (left) and primary submit button (right).
Character counter uses `.type-caption` with muted color, error color when over limit.
Submit button is a primary iconOnly Button with ArrowUp icon (xs size).
Textarea auto-grows from 1 line up to ~5 lines, then scrolls.
The root is a plain wrapper; the label sits above the bordered box and the helper or error below it.
A text field: the box shows focus however it came (border and ring-1 in --color-primary; --color-error with an error or over the limit).
accessibility: Named by label (<label htmlFor>), else the app's aria-label, else the placeholder
A shown error (or being over the limit) sets aria-invalid; aria-describedby points at the error or helper, and an app's own is kept
Submit button has configurable aria-label via submitLabel prop
Character limit is visually displayed but not announced (decorative)

props.name: id
props.description: The textarea's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: value for controlled; defaultValue for uncontrolled (cleared after a submit)

props.name: onChange
props.description: The native change event (a native text field keeps the native signature)

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: The commit, with the text: the button or Enter

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without it, aria-label, else the placeholder, names the field

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text below the box (the error replaces it)

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; shown unless touched is false or the field is disabled

props.name: touched
props.description: Leave out to show error at once; pass the field's touched state to hold it until the field is left (false hides it)

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the field and shows a spinner on the button

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with cn on the root (the wrapper around the box)

props.name: ref
props.description: The native textarea; object or callback refs both keep auto-resize

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (name, aria-*, data-*, autoFocus…) goes to the textarea
